preconditions.description: X and d are integers within the range [1, 10^9].

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == '-1' or (len(stdout_lines := stdout.strip().splitlines()) == 2 and len(n := stdout_lines[0].strip()) > 0 and n.isdigit() and 1 <= int(n) <= 10**4 and len(a := list(map(int, stdout_lines[1].strip().split()))) == int(n) and all(1 <= x < 10**18 for x in a))
postconditions.description: Output is either '-1' or a valid array of positive integers with length ≤ 10^4, each < 10^18.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() != '-1' and (X_int := int(X)) == sum(1 for mask in range(1, 1 << int(n)) if (max_sub := max(a[i] for i in range(int(n)) if (mask & (1 << i)))) - (min_sub := min(a[i] for i in range(int(n)) if (mask & (1 << i)))) < int(d))
postconditions.description: If output is not '-1', the constructed array must have exactly X subsequences where max(subsequence) - min(subsequence) < d.
